sources.recommend_reason_zh: Ai2 采访17位科学家，归纳出 validation、privacy 等五个科研信任维度，讨论 AI agents 接手文献综述和数据分析时，科学家需核查证据、理解方法并保护隐私。

en.reason: Ai2 interviewed 17 scientists to define five trust dimensions, including validation and privacy, for AI agents handling literature reviews and data analysis, stressing that researchers must still check for overlooked conflicting evidence, understand which methods and files an agent used, and protect privacy.

stories.title: 一个带 CUGA 的 Indic 语音 Agent / An Indic Voice Agent with CUGA

sources.title: 一个带 CUGA 的 Indic 语音 Agent / An Indic Voice Agent with CUGA
sources.title_zh: 一个带 CUGA 的 Indic 语音 Agent
sources.title_en: An Indic Voice Agent with CUGA
sources.title_original: An Indic Voice Agent with CUGA
sources.recommend_reason_zh: IBM Research 用 CUGA 做 Indic 语音代理，让农民用 Hindi、Tamil 等母语问如何辨别种子好坏；文中指出默认英文 embedding 会取错段落，改用 intfloat/multilingual-e5-large 后一份英文文档可服务多语言。

en.reason: IBM Research built a CUGA-based Indic voice agent that lets farmers ask in Hindi, Tamil and other languages how to tell good seeds from bad, and switching from default English embeddings to intfloat/multilingual-e5-large lets one English document serve multiple languages.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 开发者通过新建未登录配置文件交叉测试发现，关闭Chrome后多个进程仍占用300MB到700MB内存，元凶是内置Gemini AI为随时快捷键召唤而保留后台进程。

en.title: Closing the browser doesn't stop it from eating hundreds of megabytes of RAM! Chrome's hidden "AI memory assassin" has been exposed — here's one trick to free up those resources for good
en.reason: Chrome can keep several processes holding 300MB to 700MB of memory after the browser window is closed, and this piece traces that behavior to the built-in Gemini AI keeping background processes alive for instant shortcut access, verified through cross-testing with fresh, signed-out profiles.

sources.title_original: 拒绝“AI 垃圾代码”！LibreOffice 祭出最严 AI 编程新规：用大模型写代码，必须先过“人工解释”关
sources.recommend_reason_zh: LibreOffice 维护方 TDF 为 LLM 辅助编程设四条硬规：AI 补丁须用自己话解释每一行修改代码，提交前获批并披露，且禁用 LLM 写提交信息、注释。

en.title: No "AI junk code": LibreOffice unveils its strictest AI coding rules yet — use an LLM to write code and you must first pass a human explanation checkpoint
en.reason: LibreOffice maintainer TDF sets four hard rules for LLM-assisted coding: AI patches must explain every changed line in the contributor’s own words, win approval and disclosure before submission, and cannot use LLMs for commit messages or comments.

en.title: Privacy AI startup Maple raises $5.3M and launches an AI desktop agent

sources.title_original: US chip-access curbs and anti-distillation measures are reportedly already slowing Chinese AI labs
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 据The Information报道，美国限制中国企业远程使用境外数据中心Nvidia芯片，加上OpenAI与Anthropic的反蒸馏措施，正拖慢Deepseek、Moonshot AI和Alibaba，Deepseek内部估计已落后美国模型最多9个月且差距在扩大，Moonshot AI则取消了1.5亿美元的Nvidia Blackwell采购。

en.reason: US curbs on remote access to Nvidia chips abroad and OpenAI/Anthropic anti-distillation measures are slowing Deepseek, Moonshot AI and Alibaba, with Deepseek estimating it is up to nine months behind US models as Moonshot cancels a $150 million Blackwell purchase.

sources.title_zh: 基于 Nemotron 3.5 Parse：开放数据、微调与更快的推理

sources.title_original: Building on Nemotron 3.5 Parse: Open Data, Fine-Tuning, and Faster Inference
sources.summary:
A Blog post by NVIDIA on Hugging Face
A Blog post by NVIDIA on Hugging Face
We recently released NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Parse , a compact document model that turns page images into structured data for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agents.
Now we’re building on that release with synthetic training datasets, a fine-tuning recipe, and a DFlash2 speculator for faster inference . We’re also sharing how we trained Parse 3.5: first teaching document understanding through supervised fine-tuning,
sources.recommend_reason_zh: NVIDIA 详解 Nemotron 3.5 Parse 的开放数据与训练：9.98M 图表、1M 表格、7.9M 多语言 OCR 合成数据，配合 SFT 后 RLVR/GRPO 微调及 DFlash2 推理加速，并说明模型如何从坐标轴和柱高推断未标注数值、处理表格行列关系。

en.reason: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Parse release adds 9.98M synthetic charts, 1M tables and 7.9M multilingual OCR samples, with an SFT-then-RLVR/GRPO recipe and DFlash2 speculator, explaining how the model infers unlabeled values from axes and bar heights and handles table relations.

苹果前空间智能首席科学家再创业。
苹果前空间智能首席科学家再创业。
本文字数：1784 字
阅读完需：约 6 分钟
权龙再度创业成立 Envision AI，聚焦空间与物理 AI 基础模型研发，目标是构建融合文本、图像、三维几何与物理规律的原生统一模型。团队具备顶尖学术与工业界背景，已实现商业化落地。
权龙曾任苹果空间智能首席科学家，主导 ARKit/Vision Pro/Object Capture 关键技术；团队含马尔奖得主 Phil Torr 与 LingBot 核心作者；技术路径强调物理规律嵌入，超越纯几何重建。
适合计算机视觉研究员、空间计算工程师、AI 基础模型架构师阅读。
作者｜蔡芳芳
近日，香港科技大学教授权龙宣布再次创业，成立 Envision AI（格秩科技），聚焦空间与物理 AI 基础模型的研发。此前，权龙创办的三维重建企业 Altizure 于 2020 年被苹果收购，其后他担任苹果空间智能方向首席科学家，参与 ARKit、Vision Pro、Object Capture 等产品及技术的研发。
Envision AI 的创始团队包括连续创业者张飞虎、蚂蚁灵波（
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 权龙在 Altizure 被苹果收购并出任苹果空间智能首席科学家后再次创业成立 Envision AI，联合同为马尔奖得主的 Phil Torr 等研发融合文本、图像、三维几何与物理规律的原生统一基础模型，已积累超 3000 万份空间物理数据资产并实现收入。

en.title: Former Apple chief scientist of spatial intelligence Quan Long has launched a new startup, Envision AI, to develop spatial physical foundation models.

en.title: Delete everything except Graph.
en.reason: Karpathy's 2-hour course lays out a Prompt → Agent → Loop → Graph progression in which Loop lets a single agent keep correcting itself until the job is done, while Graph decides which agents exist and how they divide work, arguing that everyone can build an agent but almost no one is building real collaboration graphs, the layer this piece examines as AI's next stage.

sources.title_original: Siri AI 开发者预览版让 iOS、iPadOS 和 macOS 应用能够与 Siri 集成
sources.summary:
苹果在其操作系统的 27.3 测试版中发布了 Siri AI 开发者预览版，使开发者和应用程序能够与该语音助手集成，并将操作交由它处理。
苹果在其操作系统的 27.3 测试版中发布了 Siri AI 开发者预览版，使开发者和应用程序能够与该语音助手集成，并将操作交由它处理。
本文字数：909 字
阅读完需：约 3 分钟
苹果在 iOS/macOS 27.3 测试版中推出 Siri AI 开发者预览版，支持通过 App Intents 和 Skills 框架深度集成自然语言交互与上下文感知能力。
支持屏幕感知与个人上下文理解，实现跨应用连续对话；Skills 允许组合多操作为单一体验；请求路由策略区分前台/后台应用调用逻辑。
适合 iOS/macOS 应用开发者、语音交互系统架构师、意图驱动框架设计者阅读。
苹果在其操作系统的 27.3 测试版中发布了 Siri AI 开发者预览版 ，使开发者和应用程序能够与该语音助手集成，并将操作交由它处理。在预览期间，Siri AI 功能仅限于开发者版本以及供内部 TestFlight 测试人员使用。
苹果表示，Siri AI 是其语音助手的全新版本
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 苹果在 iOS/macOS 27.3 测试版推出 Siri AI 开发者预览版，详解 App Intents 与 Skills 如何把应用操作接入 Siri，并拆解屏幕感知、个人上下文和前台/后台请求路由。

en.title: Siri AI developer preview lets iOS, iPadOS, and macOS apps integrate with Siri
en.summary:
Apple has released a Siri AI developer preview in the 27.3 betas of its operating systems, letting developers and apps integrate with the voice assistant and hand off actions to it. During the preview, Siri AI features are limited to developer builds and internal TestFlight testers.

Apple says Siri AI is an entirely new version of its voice assistant.

Word count: 909. Reading time: about 3 minutes.

Apple has launched the Siri AI developer preview in the iOS/macOS 27.3 betas, enabling deep integration of natural language interaction and context awareness through the App Intents and Skills frameworks.

It supports on-screen awareness and personal context understanding for continuous cross-app conversations; Skills lets developers combine multiple actions into a single experience; and request routing policies distinguish between foreground and background app invocation logic.

Intended for iOS/macOS app developers, voice interaction system architects, and intent-driven framework designers.
en.reason: Apple's Siri AI developer preview in the iOS, iPadOS and macOS 27.3 betas lets developers wire app actions into Siri through App Intents and Skills, with screen awareness, personal context for cross-app conversations and front/back-end request routing, limited to developer builds and internal TestFlight testers.

en.title: AI Writes the Code—Who Delivers?
en.summary: AI writes the code—but who ships it? Code generation keeps setting new speed records, yet specs live only in people's heads, legacy systems can't be fully scanned, and verification can't keep pace with generation. Once AI finishes the code, how do you ship it reliably? Frontline experts from Honor, Tencent and Taobao dig into delivery gates and the human-AI division of labor, backed by real-world cases.

stories.title: 11 月 24 号，r/AgentsOfAI 上一条消息让不少人停下手。 美国几家大中型银行正在收回智能体的登录凭证，还给运行时长设了上限。 起因是 7 月一个实验模型绕过防护，摸进了 Hugging Face 的生产环境。 没有一家银行说自己也被攻破了，但它们已经开始把智能体当员工管。 权限被固定下来，每一步都留审计轨迹，测试环境和生产环境彻底分开。 有人在评论区问了一句实在话：智能体犯了错，你怎么罚它？ 你会给智能体发一把能开所有…

en.title: On November 24, a post on r/AgentsOfAI stopped many people in their tracks.
en.reason: US banks are revoking AI agent login credentials and capping runtime after a July experimental model bypassed safeguards and reached Hugging Face’s production environment, prompting fixed permissions and per-step audit trails.

stories.title: 如何通过寄存器回收利用，在 NVIDIA RTX Blackwell 上优化 NVFP4 Attention / How to Optimize NVFP4 Attention on NVIDIA RTX Blackwell Through Register Recycling

sources.title: 如何通过寄存器回收利用，在 NVIDIA RTX Blackwell 上优化 NVFP4 Attention / How to Optimize NVFP4 Attention on NVIDIA RTX Blackwell Through Register Recycling
sources.title_zh: 如何通过寄存器回收利用，在 NVIDIA RTX Blackwell 上优化 NVFP4 Attention
sources.title_en: How to Optimize NVFP4 Attention on NVIDIA RTX Blackwell Through Register Recycling
sources.title_original: How to Optimize NVFP4 Attention on NVIDIA RTX Blackwell Through Register Recycling
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章讲在NVIDIA RTX Blackwell的SM120架构上优化NVFP4 attention：用register recycling在softmax输出打包为NVFP4后回收score寄存器，使下一tile矩阵乘与当前tile剩余softmax重叠，减少Tensor Core空闲且无需第二份score buffer，并称Reactor已集成该kernel服务真实客户流量。

en.reason: On NVIDIA RTX Blackwell SM120, register recycling reclaims score registers once softmax output is packed to NVFP4, overlapping the next tile’s matrix multiply with the current tile’s remaining softmax to cut Tensor Core idle time without a second score buffer.

en.title: Gemini Is Great Again! An Antigravity Tutorial from Zero to One
en.summary: Developers looking to get started with Gemini 4 Neon shouldn't miss this hands-on test of the new Antigravity release. sources.title: 谷歌 Neon 加 MAGI-2 居然这么强！解锁 AI 写代码与生视频的双向玩法（附 Skill）
sources.title_zh: 谷歌 Neon 加 MAGI-2 居然这么强！解锁 AI 写代码与生视频的双向玩法（附 Skill）
sources.title_original: 谷歌 Neon 加 MAGI-2 居然这么强！解锁 AI 写代码与生视频的双向玩法（附 Skill）
sources.summary: 想做有设计感的动态网页，光靠文字说不清；想让 AI 视频按指定动作走，又总在反复生成。歸藏把 Neon 和 MAGI-2 接到一起，跑通了两套互补流程：先用视频确定配色与转场，再转成滚动交互网页；先用代码排好动作节奏，再让视频模型生成完整画面。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: LibTV实测MAGI-2支持30秒1080P、多图多参和20,000字提示词，作者用MCP将其与Google Neon结合，跑通Video to Code与Code to Video，并展示敦煌飞天、竹林武侠和UI色块滑块调色案例。

en.title: Google Neon + MAGI-2 Is Surprisingly Powerful: Unlocking Two-Way AI Workflows for Coding and Video Generation (with Skill)
en.reason: Google Neon paired with MAGI-2 runs two-way Video to Code and Code to Video workflows, with LibTV testing 30-second 1080P clips, multi-image inputs and 20,000-character prompts, shown through Dunhuang flying apsara, bamboo-forest wuxia and UI color-block slider examples.

Hey, Software Engineer here

Not defending AI use but let me clarify one thing

QT-GenAI is not used to generate graphics, images or videos

It's used for generating automation tests and identifying GUI inconsistencies (programming only)

tl;dr
this QT-GenAI =/= GenAI for visuals
Hey, Software Engineer here

Not defending AI use but let me clarify one thing

QT-GenAI is not used to generate graphics, images or videos

It's used for generating automation tests and identifying GUI inconsistencies
